acceptance_criterion: SBOM: a CycloneDX SBOM per image and for the npm workspace, uploaded as artifacts
test_name: EN-21-T1 — Every image and the npm workspace has a CycloneDX SBOM, uploaded as an artifact

acceptance_criterion: Trivy scans the filesystem (dependencies, IaC across deploy/ and the Dockerfiles, secrets); fails on CRITICAL with a fix; reports HIGH; SARIF to code scanning
test_name: EN-21-T2 — Trivy scans the repository's dependencies, Dockerfiles, deploy/ manifests and secrets; a CRITICAL finding with a fix fails the build

acceptance_criterion: Trivy scans each built image on the same terms
test_name: EN-21-T3 — Trivy scans each built image; a CRITICAL operating-system or library finding with a fix fails the build

acceptance_criterion: cosign: keyless signing of the images pushed to GHCR on main, SBOM attestations, and a verify step after signing
test_name: EN-21-T4 — A push to main signs each GHCR image keylessly, attests its SBOM, and verifies both

acceptance_criterion: cosign on pull requests: sign-blob the SBOMs and sign, attest and verify an image in a throwaway registry
test_name: EN-21-T5 — A pull request signs the SBOMs as blobs, and signs, attests and verifies an image in a throwaway local registry

acceptance_criterion: ZAP baseline against the running web app and planning-core API on a throwaway database, with a rules file and an uploaded report
test_name: EN-21-T6 — A ZAP baseline scan runs against the running web app and the planning-core API on a throwaway database; the rules file records each ignore

acceptance_criterion: Third-party actions the pipeline adds are pinned by commit SHA
test_name: EN-21-T7 — Every third-party action the supply-chain pipeline adds is pinned by commit SHA

acceptance_criterion: A guide explains how to verify an image's signature and SBOM
test_name: EN-21-T8 — documentation/supply-chain.md lets a newcomer verify an image's signature and SBOM
